subject.title: Feature request: Per-channel tool call budget with auto-delegation

question: Should OpenClaw add core scoped tool-call budgets, and if so what precedence and child-session authority should channel overflow delegation use?
rationale: The useful stability goal is clear, but the requested config and automatic delegation behavior set new product, config, and security policy that cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Design scoped warn/block first
options.body: Add a generic budget model with clear precedence and deterministic warn/block behavior before separately considering automatic subagent overflow.

options.title: Sponsor full auto-delegation
options.body: Approve a broader design that includes channel overflow spawning, inherited authority, completion routing, and upgrade/security proof in one coordinated project.

options.title: Keep as guidance only
options.body: Decline core enforcement for now and document prompt/tool-policy patterns for operators who want manual delegation.

recommendation.title: Design scoped warn/block first
recommendation.body: Add a generic budget model with clear precedence and deterministic warn/block behavior before separately considering automatic subagent overflow.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the adjacent tool-loop detection feature and already provided the maintainer-facing design review on this issue.
